title: clinopodium minae
intro: Clinopodium minae, commonly known as Minas catmint, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium minae include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
